item.title: France threatens actions against Iran over supermarket cyberattacks
item.description:
The French government has blamed an Iranian military hacking unit for cyberattacks that disrupted refrigeration systems at roughly 700 grocery stores and other retail locations last month, causing food losses and at least 15 fires. Why it matters: The attacks underscore how Iranian government hackers are moving beyond stealing data and disrupting websites to manipulating the physical equipment that keeps essential services running. Driving the news: France's Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs attributed the Oct. 11–12 attacks to Iran on Monday, calling them the country's first cyberattack campaign conducted purely for sabotage on French territory. The government's Cyber Crisis Coordination Center specifically attributed the attacks to Shahid Kaveh, a hacking unit within Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. item.title: Newly-elected Democrats react to Hegseth impeachment bid
item.description:
NA Yesterday, I wrote about why Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth deserves to be impeached and convicted for his role in in starting an unconstitutional war and perpetrating over 200 cases of outright murder with the "drug boat" strikes. Today GOP Rep. Thomas Massie filed impeachment charges in the House of Representatives. Even if they don't pass in the narrowly Republican-controlled lame duck Congress, they will almost certainly do so in the incoming Democratic one. Meanwhile prominent conservative legal commentator, national security law expert and former federal prosecutor Andrew McCarthy has published an excellent overview of the charges in the National Review . McCarthy is far to my right, and far more sympathetic to the War on Drugs (I myself believe it should be abolished ).
